nome_jp: 破戒のインガ シャンツアイ
testo:
Multi
■ When you summon this creature, reveal any number of Gods from your hand. You may reduce the summoning cost of this creature by 1 for each God revealed. It can't cost less than 2.
■ While battling, your Gods and Oracles get +3000 power.
Double Breaker
